title: Orbital Command - Steam Next Fest - Massive v1.2 demo patch
author: Enarian__Lead_Dev
selftext:
Demo Version 1.2 Launch

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5112040/Enarian\_Orbital\_Command/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5112040/Enarian_Orbital_Command/)

So about 2 weeks ago I launched the demo, put out some posts and got a varied mix of responses, and tbh many of the negative responses had valid points.. hence the long list of patch notes.

Cursor has once again shone through, debugging, optimising and improving existing systems.

That's not to say that it doesn't still require a lot of hand holding and guidance! I found it does still tend to wind up stuck in a loop of its own ideas, and I had to suggest solutions outside of that to get the best results.  


But here is  the result:  
  
Following on from the fantastic feedback from players and demo testers we have made a large number of changes to the game, here is a run down of just some of the many changes:

* All new branding, Steam Assets and Logo
* New trailer to show off the changes.
* Simplified the skyboxes so they are less distracting, they still have the nice big planet but quieter nebula like effects.
* Many changes to the UI including fixing the slight delay in opening some windows.
* All new SFX for weapons, many other systems and UI elements.
* Brand new voice over instructions and command confirmations. Sarah has never sounded better..
* Improved enemy ship tactics, they will now hit and run, target support ships, fallback and regroup and more.
* Improved lighting in the outpost and contract maps.
* Improved ship flight mechanics especially for small ships like fighters.
* Added freelook camera - Shortcut key: H
* Many improvements to the onboarding tasks including a skip button.
* New loading screen.
* All new Hex tile and Select box system to identify ships and wings more easily.
* Added HP bar to the ship hex tiles and the selected ship box now changes colour to reflect ship health,  so you can more easily see if a ship is damaged.
* New capital ship super weapon, a massive forward facing canon that takes time to charge but unleashes a devastating bolt of energy.
* The Carrier capital ship gets a mine spreader weapon that seeds a minefield around it.
* Advanced ship tactics, including micro warp and jump drives for the slower capital ships.
* New impact and ship explosion animations.
* Improvements have been made to all contract types to make them more engaging and challenging.
* All new Convoy contract type, guard a series of ore barges as they make their way to their destination.
* Contracts unlock based on commander level and additional contract types now open at low levels to provide more variation at low levels and in the demo.
* Simplified stances and added power allocation options, allowing you to increase power to weapons, shields or engines.
* Brand new modular station models.
* And many more updates applying general polish to the game.

For anyone who tried the demo when it was first released now is a great time to jump back in and try it again as we move steadily towards launch at the end of the month!
